honest_final_statement: The true state is BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD / CONDITIONAL_DEVELOPMENT. The invention is technically promising: 102 survives on the current 18-reference corpus, 103 is uncertain (no motivation evidence found but patent counsel needed), engineering is reproducible but below threshold (58/65), safety is demonstrated in model but requires preclinical validation, commercial case is below threshold (62/65) because IP and competitive blocking remain assumptions. Buyer sentiment is conditionally positive (WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES, 3/3 unanimous blind test), but buyer readiness is NOT_READY — the machine correctly reports that soft gates and composite are below threshold. These are separate fields: sentiment is what buyers feel; readiness is what the machine can certify. The next step is the evidence-to-engineering bridge: execute the in-vitro flow-loop spec (Phase 4) and preclinical validation protocol (Phase 5), then re-adjudicate with physical data.
